meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 引导你创建第一个 NanoClaw 代理：确认你在聊天频道里的身份、创建代理，并让代理给你发一条欢迎私信，验证消息能正常送达。重复操作不会产生副作用。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置且服务运行后，当你要求为某个频道初始化第一个代理并想收到欢迎私信时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 Discord 上创建第一个代理，并给我发条欢迎消息。
say.note: Claude 会先问你的身份信息，再执行创建。

say.text: 频道已经配好，开始初始化第一个 NanoClaw 代理吧。
say.note: Claude 会检查条件并触发欢迎消息。

say.text: 让第一个代理在 Telegram 上给我发一条欢迎私信。
say.note: 需先提供你在 Telegram 上的用户 ID。

howto.what_en: Guides the operator through the first agent setup: resolve channel identity, create the agent, and send a welcome DM through the normal path to verify delivery. Idempotent; safe to rerun.
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when the operator asks to initialize the first agent for a channel and receive a welcome DM.

say_en.text: Help me create the first agent on Discord and send a welcome message to me.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for your identity info first, then create it.

say_en.text: Channel is ready. Initialize the first NanoClaw agent now.
say_en.note: Claude checks conditions and triggers the welcome DM.

say_en.text: Make the first agent send me a welcome DM on Telegram.
say_en.note: You'll need to share your Telegram user ID.
